gaps.reproduction: Open Activity > Requests while authenticated; Native calls /v1/connections/requests, which resolves as connector id "requests" rather than the follow-request collection.
gaps.expectedResult: Native calls GET /v1/profiles/me/follow-requests and decodes the cursor page.
gaps.observedResult: The active Native request does not map to the follow-request API contract.
gaps.rootCause: ActivityRepository uses an outdated path; the canonical secured route already exists and its response is compatible with ActivityPayloadDecoder.

gaps.reproduction: Open the Nodus model settings card without an Info.plist/developer override; the default GreenField endpoint returns HTTP 404 in main and production.
gaps.expectedResult: A governed descriptor names immutable, digest-pinned model files for an approved Nodus release, or the client explicitly reports that no release channel is configured.
gaps.observedResult: Native constructs and fetches the default endpoint, but GreenField registers no such route and owns no approved model artifact.
gaps.rootCause: The Native download contract was added without a corresponding governed GreenField release source; adding a fabricated descriptor would weaken artifact trust.

gaps.reproduction: Publish an exported AR-composited image from StoryCamera; Native still base64-inlines the image in POST /v1/stories instead of using the attachment workflow.
gaps.expectedResult: Upload bytes through the attachment session, then create the story with attachmentId and an idempotency key.
gaps.observedResult: GreenField supports attachment-backed stories, but the pinned Native client does not consume that contract.
gaps.rootCause: Backend support landed after the current Native story request implementation.

gaps.feature: Generic module sync, revision browser, and record media bindings
gaps.reproduction: Inspect the closed ModuleBackendRequest vocabulary and ProductUI runtime; they call record CRUD/restore/purge but never call sync, revision, or record-media binding routes.
gaps.expectedResult: Offline replay consumes revision cursors/conflicts, revision UI loads history, and attachments use the generic record media binding contract.
gaps.observedResult: The backend contracts and PostgreSQL tests exist, but the current Native runtime has no caller for these required integrations.
gaps.rootCause: Native bridge vocabulary stops at record CRUD and stores attachment-like metadata as a record rather than binding uploaded attachment bytes.

gaps.reproduction: Save a Module Generator project on one device and attempt to reopen it on another; DeveloperModuleStore writes only the local application-support directory and GreenField has no draft resource.
gaps.expectedResult: Authenticated creators can create, update, reopen, and preview account-scoped drafts with optimistic concurrency.
gaps.rootCause: The Developer domain has publisher/product/build/release rows but no account-scoped project draft persistence contract.

gaps.feature: Developer release to signed registry promotion
gaps.reproduction: Create a successful verified build and then a Developer release; the row remains CANDIDATE with module_release_id null and cannot enter the registry installation path.
gaps.expectedResult: The official QA/private publication flow verifies the signed artifact, creates one immutable registry release, links module_release_id, and makes it installable by an authorized second account.
gaps.observedResult: Developer release persistence and registry publication are disconnected lifecycles.
gaps.rootCause: DeveloperService.createRelease records metadata only; no governed promotion service joins build provenance, publisher signing, registry review, and publication.

gaps.feature: Production parity with accepted GreenField main
gaps.reproduction: Compare accepted main e32409ad8b2633ca4649d19adfe7ef9c234c5125 with deployed source/image db0e1e31c19f07538198c8191fa97976c39a7684.
gaps.expectedResult: A separately approved rollout advances migrations 076 through 079 and deploys retained API/worker images after backup and recovery rehearsal.
gaps.observedResult: Production remains intentionally at migration 075 with 459 application routes; main has 484.
gaps.rootCause: Production deployment is explicitly outside this mission authority.
gaps.linkedTest: API Atlas source/runtime reconciliation and migration-validation CI
